Valerie Teo Chiropractic Pte. Ltd. was founded by Valerie Teo in 2020, located in the central area of Singapore at The Bencoolen. A 2013 Macquarie Masters grad, she is Singapore’s only local chiropractor certified for both humans and animals.  She also extends her chiropractic care to animals through her sister company, Animal Pal Chiropractic when she became a certified animal chiropractor at Options for Animals College of Animal Chiropractic, Kansas, USA since 2017.

She is also a certified Biodynamic Craniosacral therapist since 2024. When integrated with chiropractic care, BCST can enhance the effectiveness of adjustments by addressing subtle imbalances in the craniosacral system, resulting in improved overall well-being. Her primary aim is to foster positive change in every patient she treats. She recognizes that each individual’s path to recovery is unique, and hence, she is committed to staying updated with the latest advancements to better serve her patients.
